source.title: Forebears Burkina Faso forenames and surnames frequency tables

names.notes: Public frequency tables were used to seed localized given names and surnames. Gender buckets follow Forebears gender-majority data for high-frequency forenames and are not an official civil registry sample; surnames were cross-filled from the public Burkina Faso surname table.

source.title: ITU Burkina Faso national numbering plan communication of 4.V.2023

phones.notes: ITU/ARCEP confirms country code +226, fixed national significant number length of eight digits, and the listed non-geographic mobile prefixes. Generated numbers are synthetic and are not checked for current subscriber assignment or portability.

locations.notes: UPU confirms Burkina Faso addressing structure and public examples including Ouagadougou, Avenue de la Nation and five-digit postal-office style codes. Region-city mapping uses common public geography; non-Ouagadougou postalPrefixes are internal generator markers pending authoritative city-level postal-code coverage.

national_personal_identification_number.label: National Personal Identification Number

source.title: Burkina Faso Embassy passport requirements: N.I.P. a 17 chiffres

national_personal_identification_number.notes: Official passport requirements state that the personal identification number on the CNIB has 17 digits. No public checksum, semantic digit rule or live registry validation was found, so the generated value is synthetic but the length/pattern is directly confirmed.

passport.label: Passport

source.title: PRADO Burkina Faso ordinary passport document entries

passport.notes: PRADO confirms Burkina Faso passport document families and versions, but the public entry reviewed does not confirm the visible passport number grammar. The template remains a synthetic placeholder until an official rule or multiple public samples are available.
